Signal-before-Wait needs another signal; runtime-reference/sema.go:578,584,668 corroborates.

findings.reason: Wait code and comments prescribe registration, unlock, reacquire and predicate loop.
Runtime callee contract at runtime-reference/sema.go:578,584,668 establishes both orders; public-seam bounded control also exercised.
Signal/Broadcast contract and runtime-reference/sema.go:631,668 support successive wakeups and nonpersistent broadcasts.
Wait docs require Signal/Broadcast for return and lack of status/context; external goroutine may broadcast as stated.
copyChecker code and NewCond initialize as described; pre-use copying scope is as stated.
Signal calls checker then runtime; check stores address and later use of copied checker panics before notification or unlock.
